name: Nylas
description: Agent-callable access to email, calendar, contacts and meeting notetaking across Gmail, Outlook, Exchange, iCloud, Yahoo and any IMAP provider. A grant represents one authenticated mailbox and calendar; Agent Accounts provision a Nylas-hosted mailbox and calendar for an autonomous agent without an OAuth flow.

nylasApiKey.description: A Nylas API key presented as a Bearer token. The same key used for direct REST calls. Generate one at https://dashboard.nylas.com/.

additionalInterfaces.description: Model Context Protocol server, US region.
Model Context Protocol server, EU region.
Nylas v3 REST API, US region. Described by the OpenAPI contract below.
Nylas v3 REST API, EU region. Described by the OpenAPI contract below.

skills.name: Email
skills.description: List, search, read and send email messages and threads, list folders, and download attachments. Create, edit, send and delete drafts. Sending requires a preceding confirmation call over MCP.
examples: Find the most recent email from the finance team and summarise it.
Draft a reply to the last message in this thread, but do not send it.

skills.name: Calendar
skills.description: List calendars, and list, read, create, update and delete events on a connected calendar.
examples: Put a 30 minute review on my calendar tomorrow afternoon.

skills.name: Availability
skills.description: Check free and busy availability across one or more participants before proposing a time.

skills.name: Contacts
skills.description: Read contacts for a grant over MCP or REST. Create, update and delete contacts and manage contact groups over REST.

skills.name: Notetaker
skills.description: Send or schedule a notetaker for a meeting, for a grant or standalone without a connected mailbox, and retrieve recordings, transcripts and summaries.

skills.name: Scheduling
skills.description: Create and manage scheduling configurations, sessions and bookings.

skills.name: Webhook notifications
skills.description: Subscribe to change notifications for messages, events and grants, delivered by HTTPS webhook or through Google Pub/Sub or Amazon SNS.

skills.name: OpenAPI contract
skills.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the full Nylas v3 REST surface: 120 paths, 213 operations, 178 component schemas. Served as JSON at /openapi.json and as YAML at /openapi.yaml.

skills.name: Markdown documentation
skills.description: Every documentation page is available as markdown, either by requesting the page with an Accept: text/markdown header or by appending .md to its path. Responses carry an x-markdown-tokens header.

skills.name: Agent Skills
skills.description: Provider-authored operating instructions for using the Nylas API and the Nylas CLI correctly.

x-nylas.note: The interfaces above are Model Context Protocol and REST. Nylas does not currently operate an A2A JSON-RPC endpoint, so no A2A protocolVersion is declared. This card is published at the A2A well-known path as a machine-readable front door for agent discovery.
